gloss: to borrow; to use on loan

definitions.gloss: to borrow; to use on loan
definitions.explanation: To borrow something formally, especially objects, equipment, or facilities. More formal than 借りる and often used in written or official contexts. Also used for borrowing words or concepts from other languages or fields.

examples.japanese: {会議室|かいぎしつ}を{借用|しゃくよう}する。
{図書館|としょかん}から{資料|しりょう}を{借用|しゃくよう}して{研究|けんきゅう}に{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I borrowed materials from the library and used them for my research.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}には{英語|えいご}から{借用|しゃくよう}した{言葉|ことば}が{数多|かずおお}く{存在|そんざい}する。
examples.english: In Japanese, there are numerous words borrowed from English.

notes:
USAGE:
{借用|しゃくよう}する is more formal and written than {借|か}りる. It is commonly used in official documents, contracts, and academic contexts. The noun form {借用|しゃくよう} is often used in compounds.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を{借用|しゃくよう}する (to borrow something)
- [person/place]から{借用|しゃくよう}する (to borrow from)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {借用|しゃくよう}{書|しょ} (written borrowing agreement)
- {借用|しゃくよう}{語|ご} (loanword)
- {借用|しゃくよう}{証|しょう} (receipt for borrowed items)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{借|か}りる is the everyday word for borrowing. {借用|しゃくよう}する is more formal and implies an official or documented loan.
